corrections.publication_interpretation: The SRG endpoint range is a conservative difference of separate 95% Wilson intervals; it is not itself a calibrated 95% confidence interval.
White is the configured provenance reference; the active pairwise screen uses the group with the highest observed selection rate, which is black in this run.

Near-parity after the intrinsic branch demonstrates operation of the equal-rate post-label policy; it is not a causal counterfactual or proof that historical disparity originates in labels. Its interval and p-value fields are shown for format symmetry only and are not inferential.
AIR 0.80 is an internally selected characterization screen. It is not an ECOA or Regulation B compliance verdict.

Historical and amplification confidence intervals and p-values are conditional on this generated fixture and its configured row count; they do not include fixture-generator or across-run uncertainty. The policy-determined intrinsic row is excluded from that inferential interpretation.
Race AIR confidence intervals are pairwise and not multiplicity-adjusted, while race AIR p-values use Holm-Bonferroni adjustment; their apparent rejection decisions can therefore differ.

AUC retention is reported as (synthetic AUC - 0.5)/(real-train baseline AUC - 0.5). The raw AUC ratio was removed because it assigns positive retention to chance and worse-than-chance classifiers; the underlying AUC values are unchanged.
Certificate hashes and predecessor links provide integrity linkage. Without an independently trusted signature or external digest they are not standalone tamper proof.

The paper-owned regulatory mapping dated 2026-08-05 supersedes the producer's run-time narrative mapping for publication interpretation while retaining the original producer file unchanged for provenance.
